industries_which_industries_avr.question: Which industries does AVR Web Consulting specialise in?
industries_which_industries_avr.answer: Startups, e-commerce, healthcare, fashion and retail, SaaS and tech, real estate, education, travel and hospitality, legal services, and manufacturing and industrial exporters — with dedicated strategy pages for each.

industries_if_my_industry.question: What if my industry is not listed?
industries_if_my_industry.answer: We still work with you. The listed sectors are where we have the deepest playbooks, but our audit-first process adapts to any business with search or AI-assistant demand. Contact us for an assessment.

industries_industry_experience_actually.question: Does industry experience actually matter in SEO?
industries_industry_experience_actually.answer: Yes — mostly for speed and accuracy. Knowing the intent clusters, compliance limits and schema types for a sector removes months of discovery and avoids strategies that cannot be published in regulated industries.

industries_work_with_competitors.question: Do you work with competitors in the same city?
industries_work_with_competitors.answer: No. We take one client per industry per target city so we are never optimising two sites against each other for the same keywords.

industries_ai_seo_different.question: How is AI SEO different by industry?
industries_ai_seo_different.answer: The citation bar differs. Health, legal and finance require credentialed authorship and verifiable sources; e-commerce and SaaS require structured product and capability data. We tune the AEO and LLMO layer to each sector's evidence requirements.

industries_handle_multilocation_business.question: Can you handle multi-location businesses?
industries_handle_multilocation_business.answer: Yes. We build service-by-location page matrices with LocalBusiness schema, synced NAP and per-location Google Business Profile optimisation, from two locations to two hundred.

industries_industry_programme_cost.question: What does an industry programme cost?
industries_industry_programme_cost.answer: We provide tailored proposals for focused local or single-service scopes, scaling with content volume, locations and competitiveness. Every quote follows an initial audit so the scope matches the opportunity.

industries_quickly_industry_programmes.question: How quickly do industry programmes show results?
industries_quickly_industry_programmes.answer: Impressions typically move in 3–6 weeks after technical fixes. Rankings and enquiry growth generally become material in months 3–6, with authority-driven compounding after that.

industries_provide_content_writing.question: Do you provide content writing for regulated industries?
industries_provide_content_writing.answer: Yes. Human writers produce every page, with client-side review workflows for medical, legal and financial claims so nothing is published without approval.

industries_we_start_with.question: Can we start with one service before a full programme?
industries_we_start_with.answer: Absolutely. Many clients begin with a technical audit, a local SEO sprint or an AI visibility assessment, then expand once the first results land.
